_comment: Copy to config.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Thresholds are starting points from one site: re-check them at yours (docs/DESIGN.md).
_mic_period_comment: Change this whenever the mic, its position, its housing or its gain changes. Levels are not comparable across periods, and the baseline stops applying.

audio._device_name_comment: Part of the name shown by 'humwatch list-devices'. Empty uses the default input.

analysis._band_hz_comment: The hum band. Changing it changes every level: start a new mic_period, then build a new baseline.

hiss._band_hz_comment: Where a rhythmic hiss is listened for, such as a sieve or screen.
hiss._pulse_hz_comment: The range of pulse rates to look for, in pulses a second.
hiss._pulse_db_comment: How far the pulse must stand above the hiss's other fluctuations to count. Plain hiss reads about 1 dB.

calibration._file_comment: Path to the mic's calibration file. Corrects frequency response.
calibration._spl_offset_comment: dB SPL = dBFS + this offset. Leave null until measured: levels are then published as relative only.

fingerprint._comment: Tone groups in Hz, from 'humwatch learn'. Each group is the frequency range one tone drifts within.

detector._validated_comment: Set true only after the detector has been checked against stops you confirmed yourself. Until then every OFF is marked provisional.

health._floor_comment: A band L90 below this is a mic fault. Set it between the unplugged reading and the quietest real background.
health._below_baseline_comment: A band L90 this far under the stopped baseline is a mic fault, not a quiet night.

wind._comment: Experimental: not yet tested against measured wind.

clips._enabled_comment: Clips can capture voices. Read docs/DESIGN.md (Privacy) and check your local law before turning this on.

upload._url_comment: Base URL of the site, e.g. https://example.org. Empty logs locally and uploads nothing.
upload._secret_comment: Same value as ingest_secret on the server, at least 32 random characters.

clock._comment: A Pi has no battery clock and boots with a stale time, so nothing is logged until NTP has synced.
